title: Watch and phone stay in sync mid-workout, and the watch buzzes when a rest ends
description: A set logged on either device shows on the other within seconds, a late watch update no longer restarts the rest timer, and the rest-end tap is stronger.

tasks.title: Watch updates should automatically update the app and vice versa, right now for example logging a set on the watch does not show up in the app
1 Recomp v3 (6-day) Feedback: make timer reset less sensitive
Watch needs to vibrate when timer is done
